svg.title: The Systemverse — twenty system capability groups connected through an Integration & Agentic Fabric to a governed Data Core
svg.desc: Twenty universal enterprise system capability groups across Plan to Manufacture (P2M), Order to Cash (O2C), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Systems to Support (S2S), docked directly onto a full-annulus Integration & Intelligence Fabric and AI & Agentics Layer surrounding Master Data Management (MDM), Common Data Model (CDM), and Data to Reporting (D2R).
svg.text: The systems that support how your business works — connected through one Integration, Agentic & Data Core.
MDM + D2R · Data Core & Fabric Hub

g.text: APIs · iPaaS · EDI (850/810) · Event Mesh · CDC · ETL / ELT · IoT Broker
MCP · Autonomous Agents · LLMs · RAG · A2A · Evals · Orchestration

20 Enterprise System Groups: P2M (01–07) · O2C (08–11) · P2P (12–13) · S2S (14–20) · Data & Agentic Core (MDM + D2R)
